decision.overall_recommendation: VIX gate is open, so normal-conviction new entries are appropriate; pick_track_record has insufficient data (sample_size 0) so no track-record adjustment is applied. The pool skews toward clean, well-supported setups: CSCO, ENTG, FORM and F lead as genuine trend_continuation names with strong beat records, while KMT, COCO, AKAM, PVH and MRCY are reversion_bounce names elevated by fresh insider buying, crowded shorts with supportive fundamentals, or genuine recent catalysts. Two names (CSCO, PEB, DTM) were downgraded from KnifeRiskTier's 'stabilising' to 'forming' on secondary-field disagreement (see rationale). BLBD appears in the shortlist while already held (10 sh, cost $62, active $58.70 stop order) -- adding here would concentrate risk in a name already ~24% of this small ($2,576) account, so it's ranked on merit but flagged clearly rather than treated as a fresh add. The bottom of the list (TRN, TPR, APG, ICHR, ALGT) carries genuine, specific fundamental or positioning headwinds (target cuts, rising shorts, large insider selling, or inconsistent earnings) that should be weighed before selection despite technically-valid setups. Sector cap and position sizing will trim the final watchlist from this ranking.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Cisco has beaten EPS/revenue estimates all eight of the last eight quarters with accelerating growth, and Q4 FY26 was a beat-and-raise built on a 'networking supercycle' and expanding AI infrastructure deals with Nvidia/AMD.
ranked_picks.rationale: Best combination of setup and fundamentals in the pool (trend_continuation, InFibZone, Buy-rated 38/35/1). Downgraded from confirmed to forming: RangeContractionRatio 1.48 (still expanding, not settling) plus a barely-positive HigherLowPct (0.2%) disagree with a clean stabilising read.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Persistent insider selling (21 sales, zero buys, -$6.0M net) and an un-contracted range mean a further shakeout before the base firms is plausible; hardware-pricing/margin commentary is a real watch item.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Entegris beat EPS in seven of the last eight quarters with positive revenue growth every quarter and a Buy-heavy analyst base (19 buy/7 hold/1 sell); no fresh catalyst beyond a mid-August upgrade.
ranked_picks.rationale: Clean trend_continuation setup with low knife risk and a consistent beat record; the only knock is the absence of a fresh catalyst.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Modest insider selling (3 sales, no buys) and no forward catalyst mean this relies purely on the technical pattern and semiconductor-cycle tailwinds persisting.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: FormFactor beat/met EPS in six of eight quarters and just posted Q2 revenue +14%/net income +176% YoY, sending shares surging roughly seven weeks ago; heavy insider selling since (13 sales, no buys, -$2.9M) in a name already up enormously.
ranked_picks.rationale: Strong trend_continuation setup with the best growth numbers here and a clean beat record; the earnings pop is already priced in, so ranked on fundamentals+setup rather than a fresh catalyst.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The stock has had an extraordinary run and broad-based insider selling (13 transactions, zero buys) suggests insiders are trimming even as it pulls into support.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Ford beat EPS in six of the last seven quarters and posted a Q2 beat-and-raise, but net income growth actually declined -152% YoY even as revenue grew ~12%; recent news is dominated by recalls, a 41% EV sales plunge and a China-ties dispute, none clearly a fresh financial catalyst.
ranked_picks.rationale: Solid trend_continuation setup (InFibZone, RR 5.0) with a decent beat record and a recent small insider purchase; ranked below the top names because net income is deteriorating and analysts are only Hold.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Net income -152% YoY despite a revenue/EPS beat signals real margin pressure, and ongoing recall/tariff headlines add unpredictable downside the chart doesn't capture.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Kennametal beat EPS in six of eight quarters, including a large recent beat (2.96 vs 2.31) with accelerating net income growth (+290% YoY); an insider bought stock on 2026-09-11, just two days after another insider's sale -- a genuinely fresh conviction purchase.
ranked_picks.rationale: A reversion_bounce, but accelerating growth plus a very recent insider purchase rank it above several weaker trend_continuation names.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Hold consensus and a negative medium-term target revision (-7%) suggest limited analyst conviction, and it remains below both the 50- and 200-EMA with no fresh news catalyst.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Vita Coco beat EPS in six of eight quarters, most recently by a wide margin, with accelerating revenue/net income growth the last two quarters; Buy-rated (9/3/3) with an $83 average target vs $56 price, and short interest is crowded (11.8% of float).
ranked_picks.rationale: Strong reversion_bounce with genuinely improving fundamentals and large implied analyst upside; the crowded short base reads as squeeze fuel given accelerating growth and a Buy rating.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Still a confirmed downtrend with no fresh catalyst, so the bounce must hold on technicals alone near-term; a repeat of the Q4 FY25 growth dip would validate the short thesis instead.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Acadia beat EPS in six of eight quarters, with lumpy but generally positive recent income growth (Q2 net income +166%); short interest is very crowded (26% of float, 12.7 DTC) and rising (+7.8%), with no fresh catalyst.
ranked_picks.rationale: Decent trend_continuation setup, but heavily-shorted, rising short interest is a concrete headwind fighting a continuation thesis with nothing fresh to offset it.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Shorts are actively adding into a continuation setup -- a specific headwind -- and behavioral-health facility operators carry regulatory/reimbursement risk the chart doesn't show.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: PVH beat EPS eight straight quarters, most recently by a wide margin, though reported net income has been volatile/declining most quarters despite the beats; an insider bought $1M of stock on 2026-09-11, a large and very recent purchase.
ranked_picks.rationale: Reversion_bounce elevated by a large, very recent insider purchase alongside a strong beat record, despite the broader trend still being down.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Net income declined in three of the last four quarters despite EPS beats, and PVH remains in a confirmed downtrend below its 50-/200-EMA; the insider buy is encouraging but doesn't offset the profitability trend.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Mercury Systems beat/met EPS eight straight quarters with a strong recent acceleration (Q4 net income +128% YoY); shares fell on the Aug 18 print despite the beat, and insiders sold heavily around the same time (30 sales, no buys, -$41.8M) -- the largest insider-selling figure in this pool.
ranked_picks.rationale: Strong fundamentals and real analyst target upside (~42%) in a defense name, but the scale of recent insider selling is a genuine yellow flag tempering an otherwise attractive reversion_bounce.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Insider selling of $41.8M across 30 transactions right around the earnings date is the biggest insider red flag in this list and should be weighed against the analyst optimism before treating this bounce as validated.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Sunstone beat EPS in six of eight quarters with generally positive recent income growth; no news coverage at all and thin volume -- a clean but catalyst-free trend_continuation setup.
ranked_picks.rationale: Technically very clean (tight consolidation, RangeContractionRatio 0.98) with a decent beat record, but zero news and thin liquidity leave nothing beyond the pattern itself.
ranked_picks.bear_case: No catalyst and no target-revision data mean this is purely a technical/fundamental-beat story; thin average volume also means any single day's move should be weighted lightly.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: YETI beat EPS eight straight quarters, most recently by a wide margin, with a strong Q2 (net income +624% YoY off a low base); Buy-rated but analysts cut targets recently (-14.2%, thin sample) even as they raised FY26 EPS guidance post-print.
ranked_picks.rationale: Consistent beat record and Buy rating support a mid-pack reversion_bounce ranking; the conflicting recent target-revision signal and continued downtrend keep it from ranking higher.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The stock missed on sales even while beating EPS last quarter, and the sizeable recent target cut suggests some analysts see less room to run than the raised EPS guidance implies.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Southwest posted a large EPS beat (0.94 vs 0.51) but guided Q3 light; beat record is solid overall (5 of 8 recent quarters), and shares are also benefiting from a broader airline-sector tailwind (falling oil, Starlink rollout).
ranked_picks.rationale: Reversion_bounce riding both company-specific earnings strength and a genuine sector tailwind, distinguishing it from peers with no macro support.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Q3 guidance was explicitly called 'light' by the market, so the bounce depends partly on continued favorable oil prices rather than company-specific momentum alone.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: DT Midstream's beat/miss record is close to a coin flip but income growth is stable and modestly positive every recent quarter; two insider purchases in the last 90 days (most recent Aug 10) are a mild positive alongside a recent analyst upgrade.
ranked_picks.rationale: Downgraded to forming: DownUpVolumeRatio of 1.58 (still elevated selling) alongside continued negative 5-/10-day returns disagrees with a clean stabilising read despite the KnifeRiskTier label; stable fundamentals and insider buying offset some of that caution.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The elevated DownUpVolumeRatio suggests sellers remain more active than buyers day-to-day, meaning the pullback may not be fully finished despite the higher-low print.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Tango is a clinical-stage biotech with lumpy financials (a large EPS miss last quarter) but analysts raised targets sharply in the last month (+36.5%, single-analyst sample) with a Buy-heavy consensus; short interest is extreme (40% of float, ~20 DTC).
ranked_picks.rationale: Technically a clean trend_continuation bounce with a strong recent price move, but extreme short interest and no real news catalyst make this a speculative, momentum-driven pick.
ranked_picks.bear_case: This is a pre-revenue biotech that missed its most recent quarter, with insider selling (5 sales, no buys) alongside an extremely crowded short base -- the setup leans on continued speculative momentum, not fundamentals.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Dow beat EPS the last four straight quarters after a mixed prior stretch, posting a Q2 beat with a $2B cost-savings plan and raised outlook -- a real, if now ~7-week-old, positive catalyst; growth is recovering off a loss-making base rather than accelerating from strength.
ranked_picks.rationale: A cyclical materials name showing genuine recovery in a reversion_bounce setup; ranked mid-pack because the RR (3.27) is the weakest in this pool and the recovery is still off a low base.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Dow is a cyclical chemicals business recovering from a loss-making stretch; a renewed commodity or demand downturn would quickly reverse recent improvement, and the thin RR here leaves less room for error.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Flowco beat EPS in most recent quarters, including a very large beat last quarter, with generally positive revenue growth; no news coverage at all for this recently-IPO'd (Jan 2025) small-cap oil-services name.
ranked_picks.rationale: Decent beat record and Buy rating, but zero news flow, thin volume, and a short trading history limit independent confirmation beyond the raw numbers.
ranked_picks.bear_case: As a recent IPO with no target-revision history and no news catalyst, there's limited outside validation of the bull case, and oil-services names are inherently commodity-cycle-sensitive.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Innoviva beat EPS in six of eight quarters, several by wide margins, and carries the top analyst-quality score (A+) in this pool with a Buy consensus, though net income swung sharply last quarter despite the EPS beat; no news coverage.
ranked_picks.rationale: Top analyst-quality score and a consistent beat record support a mid-pack ranking, but a total absence of news and insider activity limits conviction versus more actively-covered names.
ranked_picks.bear_case: No news or insider signal to corroborate the bull case, and the royalty-based revenue model (Glaxo partnership) can be lumpy independent of underlying demand.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Pebblebrook's beat record is decent (5 of 8 recent quarters) with volatile hotel-REIT income growth; analysts cut price targets sharply (-23.9%) in the last month, and the current price is already above the latest average analyst target.
ranked_picks.rationale: Downgraded to forming: DownUpVolumeRatio of 1.54 (still notably seller-heavy) plus a very weak higher-low (+0.46%) undercut the stabilising read; combined with price already exceeding the average analyst target, this is a weak candidate despite the trend_continuation label.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The price is already above where analysts, on average, see fair value, and that target was itself just cut materially -- a concrete headwind reinforced by insider selling.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Knowles beat EPS in six of eight quarters (one large miss mid-2025) with choppy but generally positive income growth; no fresh catalyst, and heavy insider selling (8 sales, no buys, -$9.8M).
sector_capped_out.rationale: Clean trend_continuation with a decent beat record and Buy-rated coverage, but no catalyst and steady insider selling keep it mid-pack.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Insider selling has been persistent and sizeable relative to the float, with no fresh news to explain why this pullback resolves upward rather than continuing to drift.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Akamai beat or met EPS eight straight quarters, though net income growth is volatile (-25% YoY last quarter); Jim Cramer called the stock 'terrific' following results within roughly the last week, and analysts remain Buy-rated despite a recent thin-sample target cut.
sector_capped_out.rationale: Reversion_bounce with a genuinely fresh positive catalyst and an unbroken beat streak; crowded shorts (13.4% of float) read as squeeze fuel given the fresh positive sentiment.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Net income growth is deteriorating even as EPS beats continue (margin/competitive pressure), and it's still below a declining 200-EMA -- shorts are crowded and insiders have only sold, a real headwind if the fresh sentiment fades.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Blue Bird beat EPS every recent quarter with a huge Q3 print (revenue +47%, net income +532% YoY) and a small recent insider purchase; analysts are strongly Buy-rated with target implying ~50% upside. This account already holds a BLBD position (10 sh) with an active $58.70 stop-loss order.
sector_capped_out.rationale: Fundamentally one of the strongest reversion_bounce setups in the pool, but ranked below higher-conviction cleaner names given the existing position: adding here concentrates risk in a name already ~24% of this small account, with a live protective stop working independently of any new entry plan.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Beyond the general downtrend/no-catalyst risk, the practical concern is portfolio concentration -- doubling down on a name already a large share of the account with its own pending stop order.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Viasat's most recent quarter missed (-0.38 vs -0.317 est.) after a strong prior beat, with negative net income growth most recent quarters; it just announced a $1B 'Equatys' direct-to-device satellite venture with SPACE42 within the last few days -- a fresh, material catalyst.
sector_capped_out.rationale: The fresh $1B partnership announcement is a genuine, very recent catalyst that stands out in this pool, which is why it ranks this high despite weak underlying profitability.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Still an unprofitable company that just missed its latest quarter, with heavy recent insider selling (20 sales, no buys, -$21.9M) and crowded short interest -- the partnership news doesn't change the earnings trajectory.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Macy's beat Q2 EPS by a wide margin roughly a week ago, but issued weak Q3 guidance that sent the stock lower despite the beat; income growth has been extremely volatile quarter to quarter, and insiders have only sold (2 sales, no buys) in the last 90 days.
sector_capped_out.rationale: Trend_continuation technically, but the 'recent' catalyst here is negative -- management flagging a tougher Q3 comp ahead is a real headwind rather than a tailwind -- ranked below cleaner names as a result.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Management explicitly guided to its 'toughest sales comparison of the year' just before this pullback, and that guidance -- not stale data -- is the freshest information available; insider selling reinforces rather than offsets the caution.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Warby Parker's beat record is modest (mostly in-line to small beats/misses) with volatile net income growth; a late-June BofA Buy initiation is the only real catalyst and is now stale, and insiders have only sold ($17.3M) in the last 90 days.
sector_capped_out.rationale: Modest fundamentals and a now-stale analyst initiation don't distinguish this from stronger reversion_bounce peers.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Sizeable insider selling ($17.3M) against only modest, inconsistent earnings performance is a real caution, with no fresh catalyst to explain an upward resolution now.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Fortive beat EPS in seven of eight quarters, but net income growth has been highly volatile (a sharp Q3 FY25 decline, likely divestiture-related); Hold-rated with essentially no company-specific news.
sector_capped_out.rationale: Transitional trend state plus volatile underlying profitability and no catalyst put this toward the bottom of the reversion_bounce group.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Net income swung -67% in one recent quarter before recovering, a business-quality flag the technical pattern doesn't resolve, and there's no fresh news to lean on.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Ichor's beat/miss record is mixed with several large misses earlier in the year before a strong recent beat and accelerating growth the last two quarters; short interest rose sharply (+18.8%) while insiders have only sold (12 sales, no buys).
sector_capped_out.rationale: Recent earnings momentum is genuinely improving, but rapidly rising short interest combined with one-sided insider selling is a specific bear-case alignment that offsets it.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Shorts added 18.8% to their position in the latest settlement while insiders sold and made zero purchases -- real alignment suggesting informed money doesn't yet trust this bounce, despite bullish analyst targets.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: APi Group beat EPS in six of eight quarters with generally positive revenue/net income growth, but insiders sold a very large amount ($26.65M, zero purchases) in the last 90 days despite a unanimous Buy rating.
sector_capped_out.rationale: Decent beat record and unanimous Buy rating are offset by unusually large insider selling and no fresh catalyst.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Insider selling of this size against a unanimous Buy consensus is a genuine disconnect -- those closest to the business are reducing exposure even as it pulls back to what analysts call attractive.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Tapestry beat EPS every recent quarter, but Q4 revenue declined -23% YoY and management flagged the 'Kate Spade recovery is taking longer' around the Aug 13 print; analysts cut targets materially (-22.7%, thin sample).
sector_capped_out.rationale: A declining revenue quarter, a material target cut, and management's own admission of a slower Kate Spade turnaround are concrete fundamental headwinds that outweigh the EPS-beat headline.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Revenue fell 23% YoY last quarter and management itself flagged a delayed Kate Spade recovery -- real deterioration a clean chart doesn't offset, compounded by insider selling and a steep target cut.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Trinity has missed EPS estimates in roughly half of its last eight quarters, including a large Q3 FY25 miss, with inconsistent, often-declining revenue; the only notable mention is a passing favorable Cramer comment relative to peers.
sector_capped_out.rationale: The weakest beat/miss record and most inconsistent revenue trend among the Industrials names, with no real catalyst beyond a passing media mention.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: A pattern of missed estimates alongside inconsistent, often-declining revenue is a genuine fundamental red flag the technical bounce doesn't address.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Allegiant beat EPS in most recent quarters but Q2 FY26 net income declined -111% YoY despite strong +28.8% revenue growth, and analysts cut price targets materially (-10.3%, 3-analyst sample); short interest also rose sharply (+26.4%).
sector_capped_out.rationale: A material analyst target cut and rising short interest fighting this reversion_bounce, plus a profitability decline despite revenue growth, make this the weakest-supported pick in the pool.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Net income fell sharply even as revenue grew, suggesting cost or pricing pressure; analysts are actively cutting targets while shorts are actively adding -- two concrete, aligned headwinds against this specific bounce.
